name: The Legendary Murphys

evidence.note: Band calendar lists Oct 3, 6-10 PM, full band at Lily Flanagan's in Babylon; also offers an acoustic duo.
Band plays guitar-driven classic rock with male and female vocals since 2003.
Organizer page: classic and southern rock on Long Island for 15+ years.

dancing.notes: A classic rock band at bars and beach clubs. Some songs are danceable, but we found no direct sign of a dance floor.

description: A Long Island classic rock band since 2003 with male and female vocals, covering artists like Fleetwood Mac, CCR and the Allman Brothers.
reviewNotes: Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Ira's List 'Lily's Babylon' matches the band's listing for Lily Flanagan's, Babylon. Dancing rating is a guess from genre and venue.
